name: DeDanix POS for WooCommerce
author: dedanix

sections.description:
DeDanix POS for WooCommerce adds a lightweight point of sale screen for stores that use WooCommerce as their catalog, stock and order system.

It is designed for small shops, counters, showrooms and teams that need a simple way to sell in person without replacing WooCommerce.

The POS screen opens outside the regular WordPress admin layout, so staff can work in a cleaner fullscreen interface. Products can be searched by name or SKU, browsed by category, added to a compact cart, charged, and converted into WooCommerce orders.

Main features

  • Fullscreen POS screen with configurable URL slug.
  • Fast product search by product name or SKU.
  • Dedicated product search index for larger WooCommerce catalogs.
  • Category and subcategory browsing when no search is active.
  • Scanner-friendly SKU workflow using the Enter key.
  • Compact cart with quantity controls.
  • Guest customer, existing customer search and customer creation.
  • Optional customer identity document field.
  • Manual note for each sale.
  • Manual fee or discount with required reason.
  • Existing WooCommerce coupon validation.
  • Basic shipping method selection.
  • Cash and custom payment methods.
  • WooCommerce order creation using WooCommerce CRUD.
  • Stock validation and stock reduction.
  • Configurable printable receipt for 80 mm or 58 mm paper.
  • One active POS window lock in the free version.
  • HPOS compatibility declaration.

Performance

DeDanix POS creates its own read-only product search index. WooCommerce remains the source of truth for products, prices, stock and orders. The index is only used to make POS search faster.

After large product imports or catalog updates, rebuild the POS search index from the plugin settings screen.

Free version scope

The free version is intentionally focused on one simple POS register.

It does not include multi-register management, cashier shifts, cash drawer reports, offline mode, multi-location stock, fiscal integrations, delivery routes or warehouse management.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to DeDanix POS in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Configure your register name, POS URL, payment methods and receipt options.
  6. Click Open POS to start selling.
  7. Rebuild the POS search index if your catalog was imported or updated in bulk.
sections.faq:
Does this replace WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce remains the source of truth. DeDanix POS creates WooCommerce orders and uses WooCommerce products, prices and stock.

Can I use it with large catalogs?

Yes. The plugin includes a dedicated search index to make product and SKU lookup faster in the POS screen.

Does it work with barcode scanners?

Basic scanner workflows are supported when the scanner types a SKU into the search box and sends Enter.

Does it support multiple cashiers or registers?

The free version is limited to one active POS window. Multi-register and advanced cashier workflows are planned for a future commercial version.

Does it work offline?

No. The free version requires the WooCommerce site to be online and reachable.

Does it create real WooCommerce orders?

Yes. Orders are created through WooCommerce APIs and marked with POS metadata.

Does it reduce stock?

Yes. Stock is validated before checkout and reduced after the POS order is created.
